name: Hubspot connect
description: Adds the HubSpot tracking JavaScript to every page for HubSpot analytics/CRM.
project_description:
Functionality 
 
 Insert HubSpot tracking code to all pages 
 
 HubSpot provides instructions on how to embed their script but the method mentioned (insert via block) is not proper method to install the library because:

 
 Drupal isn't aware about library 
 Library won't follow Drupal library rules: loading, minification, caching etc 
 Could trigger errors and clash with other libraries. 
 
 Roadmap 
 
 Ability to exclude library for particular pages / user roles 
 
 Other HubSpot nodules 
 Hubspot API 
 
 Backend PHP library and API integration (API key required): 
 dependency on composer_manager module 
 
 HubSpot 
 
 Webform integration 
 dependency on automate module 
 Back to top
